svg.title: Figure 10 · Comparable equity curves
svg.desc: Evaluation begins at close 64 after 63-session signal warm-up plus a one-session delay. The first earned return is day 65. Every curve starts at wealth index 100; strategy and buy-and-hold initial trades pay their specified cost. Cash is not a zero-return benchmark.
